risks.name: viewport-based association
risks.detail: The existing helper identifies a layer by unique matching window-space bounds, not explicit ownership identity. It walks ancestors up to the window; retained/overlaid sibling renderers with the same bounds can make matches ambiguous or coincident. Existing exactly-one candidate/visited cap is essential and must remain. Log presence alone demonstrates a matched layer was changed, not formal board identity.

risks.name: lifecycle and layout timing
risks.detail: Configuration is scheduled in50ms attempts capped120; viewport changes can reset attempts. Added Train/predecessor layouts and orientation changes increase the number of bounded searches. Verify the actual final workout viewport receives configuration rather than assuming mounting suffices. No need new per-frame sampler.

risks.name: default policy and no restoration
risks.detail: Setting false is idempotent, but fresh control may already receive false from the framework. The comparison tests policy enforcement/coverage, not a guaranteed boolean difference; keep actual existing configuration messages when available. No new restore-on-disappear behavior in this candidate.

risks.name: noninteractive hit testing
risks.detail: Retain allowsHitTesting(false) on helper. It must not intercept Train-card buttons, gestures or projected contact accessibility.
